description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

The second push costs you nothing either, if you pick the right moment for it.

The second Redline you spend in an encounter is also clean: you roll no Slip for it. This does not stack with any other effect that makes a Redline clean, and the third and later Redlines still roll normally.

cinderfall.incomplete: The second Redline of the encounter rolls no Slip. Deadhand's "Redline"/"Slip" mechanic (spending Tally in a lump, risking a roll on a Slip table) is entirely homebrew with zero schema footprint anywhere in this corpus or on the class card itself -- no rule element writes to, reads, or modifies a resource or table of this shape.
